Chapter 6917: Kill Me

Chapter 6917: Kill Me

The wrath of the high heaven was a means to carry out judgments against sinners. Few have survived since the tribulations were proportional to cultivation.

Normally, they had to be the ones to surpass the trial. Of course, some exchanges have happened in the past. The replacements had to be far stronger. The tribulations also strengthened in this case.

At the immortal level, it became harder for these exchanges. A golden immortal didn’t dare to interfere with a grand immortal’s tribulation due to its upgradable nature. However, an immortal could interfere with an emperor’s tribulation since both could survive.

However, what if the sin was heavier than the high heaven? No one had considered this since it was impossible.

Today, it finally occurred. They felt a dao heart emerging, piercing through the judgment.

“This is the dao heart’s principle.” They thought everything returned to normal.

They weren’t the ones falling because of their dao heart but should be delivering judgment to the dark high heaven instead.

“What is this dao heart? Is it a celestial immortal?” The immortals became emotional.

Weaker cultivators didn’t have a good grasp of what was going on but the immortals did.

“No, a celestial immortal still can’t do this. Dusk and Heavenfall couldn’t back then during Heavenpit.” An immortal took a deep breath.

“Well, it wasn’t the true high heaven, only a technique of Devouring Abyss to steal its power. Looks like failure though.” A primordial immortal, a long-time enemy of Devouring Abyss, commented.

“Is the person trying to destroy the alliance? Can it be someone from Guardian?” Another speculated.

Golden Law was a potential candidate. However, due to this immortal’s lifespan, he had not appeared in a long time. He wasn’t even in control of Golden World’s judgment, let alone venturing this far.

“Ahh!” Meanwhile, Guangmai felt every jolt of pain as the giant. Unfortunately, this giant was far stronger than his mind. Thus, the suffering inflicted on the giant was more than he could take.

If he had his original body, he would have been destroyed long ago. The durability exacerbated his agony. This was far worse than death.

“Kill me, kill me now.” He couldn’t help but beg.

“This is karma and judgment, I can’t change it.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“No...” He wailed in agony, hoping for a swift death.

Unfortunately, no one could kill him now. He had to wait until the giant was utterly destroyed since he was the one who started the judgment.

“It’s a shame that the victims can’t hear your cries. Do take solace in that your essences will return to this world.” Li Qiye said.

As time passed, the tribulations escaped from the giant. Li Qiye willed them into the form of a chapter to purify the impurities within the flesh and blood.

With their help, he refined the giant into the purest liquid of life. This was of the highest level, only available to the high heaven.
